text: This S1000D document is a fault isolation procedure for front wheel tire malfunctions on mountain bicycles (Mountain Storm Mk1 or Brook Trekker Mk9). It provides a diagnostic decision tree guiding technicians to identify tire issues—checking pressure readings and physical damage—and directing them to appropriate corrective actions: deflating, inflating, or replacing the tire or inner tube. The document includes required tools and references related maintenance procedures.

# Document Description

This S1000D data module documents wiring equipment lists for a lighting system (issue 012, dated July 2026). It specifies electrical components used in bicycle wiring, including lights, battery, generator, switches, relay, distribution module, and connectors with their part numbers, installation locations on the bike frame/handlebars, and connection classifications. The document includes recent additions of strobe module and strobe switch components, along with copyright, security, and distribution restrictions from the Aerospace, Security and Defence Industries Association of Europe.
